# cpanel_calendar_delegates (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel calendar delegation inventory through `CPDAVD::list_delegates`, with a legacy `CCS` fallback only when cPanel reports that `CPDAVD` is unavailable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_calendar_delegates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `delegates` (Attributes List) The calendar delegations sorted by delegator, delegatee, and calendar identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegates))

<a id="nestedatt--delegates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `delegates`

Read-Only:

- `calendar` (String) The delegated calendar collection identifier.
- `calendar_name` (String) The delegated calendar display name, or an empty string when unavailable.
- `delegatee` (String) The DAV user that receives access.
- `delegator` (String) The DAV user that owns the calendar.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the delegate has read-only access.
